summary: Add parent-id columns to ad_groups and ads plus an append-only entity_snapshots history table.
reason: The hierarchy commands (tree, orphans, bid-check) need a local join key that the API does not return on the child objects, and drift and review-watch need snapshot history because the Ads API exposes no change-history endpoint.
validated_outcome: tree renders campaign > ad group > ad from the local store; drift and review-watch read entity_snapshots.
